title: potentilla hirta subsp. euhirta
intro: Potentilla hirta subsp. euhirta, commonly known as Himalayan cinquefoil or rough-leaved cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family that is native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla hirta subsp. euhirta include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
